# Elijah Prays for Rain (1 Kings 18:44)

## Emotional Focus
Praying for something the whole land needs.

## Key KJV
“And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud.” (1 Kings 18:44)

## Gentle Retelling
Elijah prayed for rain after a long dry time. He kept praying until a small cloud appeared and God sent the rain.

## Coloring Prompt
Elijah praying on the mountain while a small cloud grows into rain.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God hears prayers for big needs too.”
